description: This Java source file defines Swagger API documentation classes for Self Loans API in the Fineract project, including response structures, request models, and nested data classes for self loan operations.

classes.name: SelfLoansApiResourceSwagger
classes.description: Contains nested classes representing Swagger API response and request models for self loan operations.

classes.name: GetSelfLoansLoanIdResponse
classes.description: Represents the response structure for retrieving self loan details by loan ID.

classes.name: GetSelfLoansLoanIdTransactionsTransactionIdResponse
classes.description: Represents transaction details for a specific loan transaction.

classes.name: GetSelfLoansLoanIdChargesResponse
classes.description: Represents charge details associated with a loan.

classes.name: GetSelfLoansTemplateResponse
classes.description: Template response for creating or editing a self loan, including client info and product options.

classes.name: PostSelfLoansRequest
classes.description: Model for creating a new self loan request.

classes.name: PostSelfLoansResponse
classes.description: Response after creating a self loan, including IDs.

classes.name: PutSelfLoansLoanIdRequest
classes.description: Model for updating an existing self loan.

classes.name: PutSelfLoansLoanIdResponse
classes.description: Response after updating a self loan, including changes.

classes.name: PostSelfLoansLoanIdRequest
classes.description: Model for withdrawing a self loan application.

classes.name: PostSelfLoansLoanIdResponse
classes.description: Response after withdrawing a self loan application.
